purpose: Execute the fixed action contract using a transparent learned-PCA Gaussian reference before training a policy. This is an established Gaussian goal-design control, not a new-method claim.
prior: Training8000 images only; centered randomized PCA maxrank128, oversampling32, four power iterations; independent standard Gaussian latent coefficients
approximation_error: Per-real-channel variance of discarded PCA signal estimated on train8000 and added to instrument noise variance. Query readout adds train-average discarded-field energy. Omitted-mode cross-correlations are not modeled; no claim this is the true image posterior.
initial_validation_objects: first20 IDs in the existing validation split, fixed order; method-development prototype, no final assessment
objective: All15 normalized query squared errors, equal weight; both plug-in and Gaussian mean responses retained
uniform_rule: Choose remaining block with largest circular distance to selected block centers; lowest-index tie break
random_rule: Fixed per-object RNG; no look-ahead truth
second_order_rule: Same first-order term plus sum_j 2tr(Q_j Delta Q_j Delta)/scale_j^2; exact expected Bayes-risk reduction only inside the declared Gaussian surrogate
selection: No policy or rank chosen on truth; report both ranks and all policies across additional budgets0–10
